thread:
Ana: Kickoff: FinTech prospect (ACME Bank) needs BYO HSM + cross-region key replication, FIPS attest, rotation every 90d, and no key escrow. They want a 4-week POC next month and a pricing delta for HSM connector + premium support. @Elena @Maya can you scope?

Elena: Got it. Quick ask: what HSM model/type are they planning (AWS CloudHSM, Thales Luna, Entrust, YubiHSM)? Also which regions for replication? This affects connector work.

Maya: Security checklist before POC: 1) key generation location (customer HSM or import) 2) attestation requirement 3) audit log destination (their SIEM?) 4) rotation orchestration owner 5) escrow/backup policy. Send them the short questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-poc

Jared: Ops notes: adding remote HSMs implies network setup (VPC peering / PrivateLink) + latency hit per crypto call (~10-35ms depending on region). We should capture SLO impact and traffic patterns. Also, HSM endpoints may have connection limits; plan for pooling.

Tim: From runtime side we can support a dual-wrap design (customer KEK in HSM + Redwood envelope key). We never persist plaintext KEKs. Fallback behavior: cache DEKs with a short TTL for hardening against transient HSM outages — propose 30s default. Need to agree on TTL vs security tradeoff.

Ana: Customer asked whether Redwood can automate rotation while still keeping BYO HSM ownership. They want rotation every 90 days with rotation logs shipped to them. Feasible?

Maya: Feasible if HSM supports programmatic rotation/operations (CloudHSM or Thales APIs). Flow: orchestrate new key creation in HSM -> wrap existing DEKs under new KEK -> promote new key id -> emit audit events. Requirements: HSM admin credentials + attestation artifacts. We will not store plaintext keys; only wrapped blobs. Also legal: if customer insists "no escrow" we need to confirm backup strategy — we usually recommend wrapped backups but that may require legal exceptions.

Elena: POC plan (high-level):
- Week 0: NDAs + SOW + customer provides HSM access matrix
- Week 1: network provisioning (peering/PrivateLink) + credential exchange
- Week 2: deploy connector, complete HSM attestation, basic get/put smoke tests
- Week 3: implement rotation workflow & forwarding of audit logs
- Week 4: perf and failover tests, handoff + runbook
Pricing: estimate 80-120 eng hours for POC + connector setup fee $12k + infra costs per region. Add a professional services discount option if they commit to Dedicated.

Ana: They said they will provide Thales Luna appliances on-prem and want HSM hardware custody. Also asked if keys need re-wrap during model migrations (we host model cache and may rekey).

Tim: Re-wrap flow: yes, DEKs would be re-wrapped under a new KEK and we can do atomic switch with shadow traffic testing. Expect a small maintenance window unless we run shadow migration. We'll propose a non-blocking re-wrap pattern. Example rotation CLI we plan to use in POC:
```
redwood kms rotate --key acme/dek --rotation-window 90d
```

kms-onboard-bot: Checklist created: POC request #1799998888 assigned -> Elena (solutions), Maya (security), Tim (runtime). Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/poc/1799998888

Maya: Blockers: legal flagged export-control for cross-border replication and a firm "no escrow" from customer — legal needs to review if we can meet compliance without escrow for backups. Also need attestation docs from Thales vendor.

Ana: Next steps: I'll push questionnaire and collect the environment matrix by EOD tomorrow. Can we have a pricing ballpark by EOD Friday? @Elena @Tim

Elena: I will draft eng estimate today and send a short SOW draft.

Tim: I'll run a quick perf run in staging using a CloudHSM mimic and share numbers by Thursday.

Ana: Thanks all :thumbsup:
